title: Meal Plan Ingredient Coverage for the Week
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealplan:item
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(on_hand="true")) as successful by _time week_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for meal-plan ingredient coverage by week.
value: Coverage percentage shows whether the meal plan is genuinely supported by inventory or still mostly aspirational.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for meal-plan ingredient coverage events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for meal-plan ingredient coverage by week.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often meal-plan ingredient coverage works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
